unitAI-q02sz.description:
PROBLEM: Operator session crash, reproduced with stack 2026-09-08: this.child.invalidate is not a function at MouseRegion.invalidate, via applyXtrmChrome -> setTheme -> invalidate walk during handleResumeSession/rebind. Root cause, source-verified: unitAI-55yjs humanResultOf()/humanCallOf() return {dispose(){}, render:()=>lines} with NO invalidate() method. pi wraps every tool result/call renderer in MouseRegion (tool-execution.js createResultRegion); the next theme/invalidate walk calls child.invalidate() on our object and the session dies. The pi Component contract requires invalidate (Container, Text, TranscriptPane all implement it). Same latent shape in humanCallOf. (The fleet inspector factory has the same missing method but ui.custom panes are not invalidate-walked the same way.)

SUCCESS: humanResultOf/humanCallOf return objects with dispose, invalidate (no-op), and render; render() recomputes from the tool result on every call (no stale closure over first-render lines); resume + setTheme with rendered specialist results no longer throws; operator confirms resume works with results in transcript.

SCOPE: Specialists repo only: the two builder functions in config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs + unit tests asserting invalidate exists and render recomputes (expanded toggle correctness). No other changes.

NON_GOALS: Fleet, seam, hint, telemetry work; pi-tui hardening (upstream could make MouseRegion defensive, but our contract breach is the defect -- report upstream separately, do not depend on it).

CONSTRAINTS: Machine JSON byte-identical (55yjs guarantee stands). Suite green, tsc clean. No src/dist changes.

VALIDATION: Unit tests (returned object has callable invalidate; render reflects expanded flag on re-call, not first-call closure); operator resume-with-results re-check recorded in bead notes.

OUTPUT: Commit on the current merge branch (fix/unitAI-crjh7 stack + 55yjs merge 09aa77f7), operator confirmation in notes. Notify 31s3 lane to rebase (his origin branch carries the crashing code).

SCRUTINY: low
unitAI-q02sz.notes: FIXED BY COORDINATOR DIRECTLY (specialist bridge down after crash-restart): humanResultOf/humanCallOf now expose invalidate(){}; render recomputes per call. Commit b4466c9e on fix/unitAI-q02sz-render-invalidate, pushed. 97/97 extension tests (10 new contract tests), tsc clean. Bead stays open pending operator resume-with-results confirmation.
